education.title: Education & Experience
education.description: Here is a small glimpse into my journey to becoming a web developer

viden_djurs.title: Viden Djurs, Grenaa
viden_djurs.desc_html:
When I finished the basic course, it was not possible to continue with the main course at Aarhus Tech.
Therefore I ended up taking the main course at Viden Djurs in Grenaa.
Before that, a classmate and I started the main course in Aalborg, but we quickly switched to Grenaa as we did not think the teaching was good enough.
It turned out to be a really good decision to go to Viden Djurs, and I finished my education with a very good result.

aarhus_tech_gf2.title: Aarhus Tech, Aarhus N
aarhus_tech_gf2.desc_html:
Basic Course 2 also took place at Aarhus Tech, but in one of their other departments.
Here the course was aimed more towards web development, and I learned the fundamentals of making websites.

aarhus_tech_gf1.title: Aarhus Tech, Viby J
aarhus_tech_gf1.desc_html:
After continuation school, I started my youth education.
I started on Basic Course 1 of the web developer education at Aarhus Tech.
Basic Course 1 was not so targeted at web development, but was something I had to go through, as I came straight from 10th grade.
However, I still learned something about design and teamwork, which I could then take with me.

himmerlands.title: Himmerlands Ungdomsskole, Aars
himmerlands.desc_html: After primary school I chose to take 10th grade at a continuation school to try something new, meet some new people and perhaps also become a little more confident. Unfortunately the last half year was a bit spoiled when covid-19 arrived, but it was still a fantastic experience.
